newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds follow Chicago sharply down.
newsitem.headline: European feeds follow Chicago sharply down.

text.p: Sellers on the European meals and feeds market offered South American soymeal pellets as much as $11 lower, following last night's sharply lower Chicago soymeal futures, market sources said.

"Chicago dropped sharply on reports the U.S. was importing Brazilian beans and meal. Over the last weeks South American soymeal prices dropped around 20 per cent, which finally boosted some buying interest," one broker said.
Argentine sunmeal pellets were offered $3 to $6 lower in sympathy with soymeal. In this product some bids were seen at around $3 under sellers' ideas.
Most other products were quoted unchanged to $2 lower.
Despite the increased buying interest no trades were reported during the initial stages of the market.
"In a falling market it is difficult doing business and the high dollar also does not really help to get buyers and sellers together," one dealer said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
